# admin tools

## `admin_embedding_stats_query`

Query embedding/reranker call tracking stats for vendor cost reconciliation.

- Permission: `manage_users`
- Source: [admin/admin_embedding_stats_query.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/admin/admin_embedding_stats_query.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `provider` | string (one of: `voyageai`, `cohere`) | no | Filter by provider: 'voyageai' or 'cohere' |
| `purpose` | string | no | Filter by purpose: 'index', 'refresh', 'query', 'temporal', 'key_test', or 'cache_shadow_audit' |
| `golden_repo_alias` | string | no | Filter by golden repo alias |
| `job_id` | string | no | Filter by job id |
| `start_time` | number | no | Filter to records with occurred_at &gt;= this Unix timestamp |
| `end_time` | number | no | Filter to records with occurred_at &lt; this Unix timestamp |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum records to return (1-1000, default 200) |
| `offset` | integer | no | Pagination offset (default 0) |

## `query_audit_logs`

Query security audit logs with optional filtering (admin only).

- Permission: `manage_users`
- Source: [admin/query_audit_logs.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/admin/query_audit_logs.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `user` | string | no | Filter by the acting user (the admin_id column) |
| `action` | string | no | Filter by exact action_type (exact, case-sensitive match; e.g. 'password_change_success', 'token_refresh_failure', 'pr_creation_success', 'git_cleanup', 'group_create'). |
| `action_type` | string | no | Same as action (either name may be used) |
| `target_type` | string | no | Filter by exact target type (e.g. 'user', 'group', 'repo', 'auth') |
| `target_id` | string | no | Filter by exact target id |
| `outcome` | string (one of: `success`, `failure`, `denied`, `attempted`) | no | Filter by outcome |
| `source` | string (one of: `rest`, `mcp`, `web`, `system`) | no | Filter by the front door the action came through |
| `ip_address` | string | no | Filter by exact client IP address |
| `correlation_id` | string | no | Filter by correlation id (every row written for one request shares it) |
| `from_date` | string | no | Start of the UTC range, inclusive: YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO 8601 date-time (e.g. '2024-01-01' or '2024-01-01T08:00:00Z') |
| `to_date` | string | no | End of the UTC range, inclusive: YYYY-MM-DD (the whole day) or an ISO 8601 date-time |
| `tier` | string (one of: `all`, `security`, `auth_activity`) | no | Which rows to read: all (default), security (every non-authentication row plus password changes, rate-limit trips, security incidents and impersonation) or auth_activity (routine logins, token... |
| `cursor` | string | no | Paging token from a previous response (next_cursor for older rows, prev_cursor with direction 'newer' for newer rows). |
| `direction` | string (one of: `older`, `newer`) | no | Paging direction for cursor; 'newer' requires a cursor |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of entries to return |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number for offset pagination (1-based); prefer cursor |
| `aggregate` | boolean | no | With tier 'auth_activity', return counts grouped by action and outcome instead of rows (last 24 hours unless a date range or all_time is given) |
| `all_time` | boolean | no | With aggregate, lift the default 24 hour window. |
